ticker_news.title: Where Will American Express Be in 5 Years?
ticker_news.description: American Express has outperformed the broader market in the past five years, and is expected to continue growing its revenue and payment volume. However, the current valuation is a concern, and future returns may not be as high as in the past.
ticker_news.author: Neil Patel

SPY.title: 4 Simple ETFs to Buy With $1,000 and Hold for a Lifetime
SPY.description: The article discusses building a diversified ETF portfolio with four funds - SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, Invesco QQQ Trust, Vanguard Small-Cap ETF, and iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF. The author suggests this mix can provide stability, value, and growth potential for long-term investors.
SPY.author: Anders Bylund

QQQ.title: Want to Collect $50,000 in Dividends per Year in Retirement? Here's How
QQQ.description: The article discusses how to build a portfolio that can generate $50,000 in annual dividends. It recommends investing in growth stocks like the Invesco QQQ Trust ETF early on, then transitioning to dividend-focused funds like the Invesco High Yield Equity Dividend Achievers ETF as retirement approaches.
QQQ.author: David Jagielski
